youtube.title: She Does Everything. It's Never Enough. (Until She Reads It Again)
youtube.description:
Six in the morning. Lunchboxes, a project due Friday, the dentist, homework, dinner, laundry.
She ticks every box, and all she hears is what's missing: a missing part at work, an argument every night, a dinner that was just OK, help that felt wrong.
One night, on the laundry room floor, she wonders if she is failing at everything.

So we turn the pages back, and read them again.

She was never the missing piece. You're doing better than you think. Keep going.

Hand-drawn stories that keep you going. ✏️
New stories every week on PencilStories.
